title: Kansas City Chillhop 🚆
description:
Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride past an illustrated Kansas City at golden hour: the Liberty Memorial tower on its green hill, art-deco towers glowing in the low sun, red-brick warehouses and leafy parks under a soft lavender sky, set to mellow chillhop the whole way.

Lofi Train POV: cozy illustrated train-window journeys through the world's cities, set to relaxing chillhop. A new city every day. Sit back, look out the window, and stay as long as you like.

Stylised illustrated artwork; not real footage.
Music: "Moving Landscapes" and "Wonderment" by Purrple Cat (purrplecat.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were trimmed and cross-faded.
